_readme: You do not describe your photos - the AI looks at them. It sorts each into villa / beach / nature / culture and takes hashtags from the matching list. EDIT 'call_to_action' - those are your booking lines and the AI never writes them. One is picked at random each post. Instagram captions cannot contain clickable links, so they must point at the link in your bio.
